title_vi: Checklist trước khi sang Đài Loan: giấy tờ, hành lý, hải quan
title_en: Pre-departure checklist for Taiwan: documents, luggage and customs
title_zh: 赴臺前檢查清單：文件、行李與海關
excerpt_vi: Danh sách việc cần chuẩn bị trước khi sang Đài Loan theo trang chính thức của BOCA, Cơ quan Di trú, Hải quan và Bộ Giáo dục: thị thực, ARC, tiền mặt, thực phẩm.
excerpt_en: What to prepare before going to Taiwan, based on BOCA, NIA, Customs and MOE pages: visa, ARC, cash declaration and food rules.
excerpt_zh: 依領事事務局、移民署、海關與教育部頁面，整理赴臺前需準備事項：簽證、居留證、現金申報與食品規定。
image_alt: Hành lang khu cửa hàng và quầy thông tin trong nhà ga sân bay quốc tế Đào Viên, Đài Loan, hành khách đi lại
image_credit: Ảnh: Plum blossom TW / CC BY 4.0 / Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Taoyuan_Airport_T1_Concourse_A_18-07-2026.jpg)
body_en: Before departure, check the documents for your visa category. BOCA's page for student resident visas lists an online form, two 45x35 mm photos, a passport valid for six months, a health certificate issued within three months, and school approval and admission letters. MOE rules require new students to hold medical and injury insurance valid for at least six months. After arrival on a resident visa, the NIA guideline says to apply for an Alien Resident Certificate within 30 days at the local service center, with photos, passport and visa, proof of purpose and proof of residence; residence fees start at NT$1,000 for one year and processing takes about 10 working days. Customs says almost all land-animal meat products are banned, with fines of NT$10,000 to NT$1,000,000 for undeclared items, and lists declaration thresholds of NT$100,000, RMB 20,000 and US$10,000. Check current pages before flying; TB GROUP can help.
body_zh: 出發前請依簽證類別確認文件。領事事務局學生居留簽證頁面列出：線上申請表、兩張45x35公釐照片、效期6個月以上護照、3個月內體檢證明，以及學校核准函與入學許可。教育部規定新生須有至少六個月的醫療及傷害保險。持居留簽證入境者，依移民署指引須於入境翌日起30日內向居住地服務站申請居留證，需照片、護照與簽證、居留事由與住所證明；居留費用1年1,000元起，審查約10個工作天。海關表示幾乎所有陸生動物肉製品皆禁止攜帶，未申報可處新臺幣1萬至100萬元罰鍰，並列出現金申報門檻新臺幣10萬元、人民幣2萬元、美金1萬元。出發前請再查官方最新頁面，歡迎聯繫TB GROUP。
